description: Drought Communities Programme Extension is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. The Drought Communities Programme (DCP) Extension supports communities in the most drought-affected regions of Australia, funding local councils to complete local infrastructure and other drought relief projects. As at 28 January 2020, 180 Councils have access to $301 million in funding providing an economic stimulus, creating jobs and supporting local communities. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. Its tags are community infrastructure, drought, regional development. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-02-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
